unicodeIdentities.rule: Prefer stable canonical Unicode-based URLs for standard production pages.

variationSelectors.rule: Never merge distinct canonical identities because rendered appearance is similar.

extras.rule: Preserve /emoji/extra-* URLs unless explicit migration approval exists.

sourceSpecificIdentities.rule: Do not automatically map source-specific identities to Unicode identities.

artworkOnlyIdentities.rule: Do not create indexable URLs merely because artwork exists.

futurePages.rule: Do not index until a production route exists.
